applies_why: The judge text decides whether C4/Jeremiah 22:30 is an unanswered witness and declines to count it because the pressed curse limb was dropped and no live link remains.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: The phrase 'counts as an unanswered witness' could be read as counting any mention of a pressed verse, or as counting only a verse pressed toward a live/broken link; the judge chooses the latter by saying no live link remains.
why: The judge does not count Jeremiah 22:30/C4 toward a broken link; it finds no live link remains after the defender dropped that limb, and not counting obeys K-G4.
